before: After a new table, row, or column, the caret named the paragraph id the store minted. In a room that id is renamed before the caret is placed, so typing was refused as unknown-paragraph. insertTable also left DOM focus on the control that ran it.
after: The caret follows the created paragraph to its replicated id by its position in reading order, so typing lands in the new cell, and insertTable focuses the pages.
reason: Only the local caret and focus change. The inserted table, row, and column ops, shared nodes, ids, and protocol messages are unchanged; presence now names an id the room holds.
